name: pull-out specimens
definition_zh: 通过拉拔试验考察钢筋与混凝土界面黏结性能的试件。

complete_examples.text: The research issues mainly concern the dosages of straw ash, the diameter of rebars, and the strength grades of concrete, in which 144 concrete specimens, 108 pull-out specimens and 30 corroded specimens are studied.
The pull-out specimens of the test program were designed in such a way that observable factors can be quantified.
